answer_1.quote: LASP uses Python codes that are generated and optimized by LLMs as spatial relation encoders.
answer_1.outputs: Python code for spatial relation encoders, symbolic expressions, VLM image prompts

answer_2.quote: LASP achieves 52.9% accuracy on Nr3D, and offers advantages in grounding time and token cost compared to previous training‑free 3D visual grounding methods.

answer_4.quote: The human involvement in this study was a small group of volunteer experts who qualitatively annotated some relation encoders.
answer_4.guideline: Qualitative annotation of generated relation encoders by volunteer experts.
